description: Form 6251 line 1b is AGI less Form 1040 line 14 and is entered as a negative amount when less than zero; taxable income is floored at zero but AMTI is not. Single 2025: wages $100,000, Schedule C loss $150,000 → AGI −$50,000; standard deduction $15,750; ISO spread $300,000. Line 1b −$65,750, line 2a +$15,750, line 2i +$300,000 → AMTI $250,000. Exemption $88,100 → line 6 $161,900 × 26% = $42,094; regular tax $0 → AMT $42,094. (Starting from taxable income $0 gave AMTI $315,750.)
